{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove QA rows first
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999,999.99'
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# Even though no commas were found in the remaining data,
# do it safely to handle any potential Excel formatting
if df_clean['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any():
    df_clean['revenue_clean'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
else:
    df_clean['revenue_clean'] = df_clean['revenue'].astype(float)

# Now compute the raw conversion rate by channel
# The question asks for the raw difference: email minus paid_search
# So we compute the mean of 'converted' for each channel
raw_conversion_email = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
raw_conversion_paid_search = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
raw_difference = raw_conversion_email - raw_conversion_paid_search

# Print the required numbers
print(f"Raw conversion rate (email): {raw_conversion_email:.4f}")
print(f"Raw conversion rate (paid_search): {raw_conversion_paid_search:.4f}")
print(f"Raw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_difference:.4f}")"}
